note: Design coefficients of the game model (v0, vertical slice). These are NOT real-world measurements. Each coefficient documents its intent; all are subject to calibration against real baseline data in Phase 9-10. v0.2 (2026-10-05): sentiment uses deviations from baseline so an unshocked world is a stable equilibrium. v0.3: recurring floods (exposure -> damage, mitigated by protection) and budget sector intensities. v0.4 (2026-10-06): exponential flood severity independent of exposure, after real IRBI exposure made all 397 listed regions flood-prone. v0.5 (2026-10-06): flood frequency from BNPB event history (Poisson events/month), severity scaled by IRBI-derived risk profile and infrastructure resilience; flood_exposure removed (D-032). v0.6 (2026-10-06): national price_pressure (commodity/import shock) multiplies every region's price target (D-045). v0.7 (2026-10-06): fire_prevention capacity; fire-season episodes are scripted cases scaled by prevention (D-046).

food_capacity.label: Kapasitas Pangan
food_capacity.desc: Local food production capacity relative to local demand (1.0 = self-sufficient).

food_supply.label: Ketersediaan Pangan
food_supply.desc: Effective supply/demand after logistics, disruption and inter-regional trade.

logistics.label: Logistik
logistics.desc: Derived each tick from infrastructure and damage.

damage.label: Kerusakan
damage.desc: Unrecovered disaster/shock damage. Decays via recovery.

welfare_base.label: Kesejahteraan Struktural
welfare_base.desc: Structural welfare level that current welfare converges to absent shocks; to be calibrated from IPM/poverty baselines. Raised by long-term policy.

sentiment_base.label: Dukungan Struktural
sentiment_base.desc: Region's structural support level; sentiment converges here when conditions equal baseline. To be informed by real context only where defensible; otherwise neutral.

flood_protection.label: Proteksi Banjir
flood_protection.desc: Flood-control capacity (drainage, embankments, retention, early warning). Reduces flood severity, not occurrence.

flood_damage_last.label: Dampak Banjir Bulan Ini
flood_damage_last.desc: Damage added by a flood this month (0 if none). Derived each tick; never calibrated.

flood_risk_profile.label: Profil Risiko Banjir
flood_risk_profile.desc: DERIVED from the official BNPB IRBI flood risk score (100 x score/36). Not an official percentage. Modifies flood severity (vulnerability/capacity composite).

flood_frequency.label: Frekuensi Banjir Historis
flood_frequency.desc: Expected recorded flood events per year, from BNPB event history (Gamma-Poisson). Drives monthly event probability.

fire_prevention.label: Pencegahan Kebakaran Lahan
fire_prevention.desc: Additional land/peat fire prevention capacity built during the term (enforcement, rewetting, community fire governance). Reduces the severity of simulated fire-season episodes. 0 at start by design.

recovery_base_rate.intent: Monthly share of damage recovered at average capacity.

damage_logistics_penalty.intent: Fraction of logistics lost at 100 damage.

damage_food_penalty.intent: Fraction of local food realization lost at 100 damage.

logistics_food_floor.intent: Food realized when logistics is fully disrupted, as share of normal (logistics relative to the region's own infrastructure).

trade_share_max.intent: Max share of food supply that equalizes with national pool when logistics=100.

price_elasticity.intent: Price response to supply shortfall: target = 100 * supply^-elasticity.

price_smoothing.intent: Monthly convergence of price toward target.

welfare_smoothing.intent: Monthly convergence of welfare toward target.

welfare_price_weight.intent: Welfare points lost per price index point above 100.

welfare_damage_weight.intent: Welfare points lost per damage point.

welfare_services_weight.intent: Welfare points gained per service point above 50.

sentiment_smoothing.intent: Monthly convergence of sentiment toward target.

trust_smoothing.intent: Trust drifts slowly toward sentiment (long memory).

sentiment_w_welfare.intent: Sentiment points per welfare point above/below welfare_base.

sentiment_w_price.intent: Sentiment points lost per price index point above 100 (gained below).

sentiment_w_trust.intent: Sentiment points per trust point above/below sentiment_base (historical memory).

sentiment_w_environment.intent: Sentiment points per environment point above/below 50.

sentiment_w_damage.intent: Sentiment points lost per unrecovered damage point (visible suffering, beyond welfare).

flood_mitigation_max.intent: Share of flood damage prevented at protection 100 (never 100%: residual risk).

budget_fiscal_rate.intent: Fiscal-space points per month per unit of spending level above/below 1.0 (level 1.1 -> -0.5/month).

budget_infra_rate.intent: Infrastructure points per month per unit of sector intensity above/below baseline funding.

budget_services_rate.intent: Service points per month per unit of sector intensity above/below baseline.

budget_food_rate.intent: Relative food-capacity change per month per unit of sector intensity above/below baseline.

budget_protection_rate.intent: Flood-protection points per month per unit of disaster-sector intensity above/below baseline, scaled by exposure/100 (money goes where the hazard is).

budget_recovery_weight.intent: Recovery-rate multiplier slope per unit of disaster-sector intensity (intensity 2 -> 1.5x recovery).

flood_severity_mean.intent: Mean damage points per flood event before modifiers (Exp distribution). DERIVED by scripts/pipelines/calibration/build_hazard_calibration.py to preserve the validated national expected flood damage while using REAL BNPB frequencies. Population-based empirical anchor pending (G-01).

flood_severity_cap.intent: Upper bound of one flood's damage (order of the scripted 2020 Jakarta event, 35).

flood_risk_scale_min.intent: Severity multiplier at risk profile 0; multiplier = 0.5 + profile/100 (median IRBI ~1.0).

price_pressure_decay.intent: Monthly fractional decay of national commodity price pressure absent policy (markets partly adjust). Design value, uncalibrated.

calendar.note: Tick 0 = January of term year 1 (fictional calendar year). Chosen so the rainy-season peak opens the term, matching CASE-0001.

flood_season.note: Generic monthly factor (Jan..Dec) for a monsoon pattern with a December–February peak. NOT valid for all of Indonesia (parts of Maluku have a different rainy season). To be replaced by per-region BMKG climate normals.
